text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup is here at last. Gold City turns to me asking why I was so persistent in making sure she kept running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her it was because I understood she wanted to run. She laughs at me, astonished.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City tells me that she's glad to have chosen me as her trainer. Promising that she'll run like herself, she heads off to today's race of champions!
